title: Omakase Counter Series
description: Four reference-linked sushi studies preserving one hinoki counter and camera logic while changing fish and form.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the hinoki surface, camera distance, and disciplined spacing. Images 02-04 preserve that exact omakase system while rotating among tuna, sea bream, and uni preparations.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-hinoki-counter-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
